spec_cite: docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §3 (idle timeout 30 s -> classify 601; transport close carries the registry code)
docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §5.2 (any: idle timeout -> transport close carrying 601)
description: Idle timeout (30 s of silence, keep-alives failing): NO control frames — the QUIC application close carries code 601; the Client classifies 601 and reconnects with backoff.
preconditions: Session PLAYING; no application messages for 30 s and no media (keep-alive probes at 10 s intervals fail to elicit ACKs).
601 is also the classification for transport loss without a Close, the 10 s auth deadline, and the 10 s per-request timeout (spec §3, §5.2, §5.3).

steps.note: No control frames are sent or expected; the QUIC application close carries code 601.

assertions: Expected control-stream bytes: NONE — like 301-at-capacity, this failure mode signals only via the transport close code.
The idle timeout is the fallback when a Close cannot be delivered (spec §3, D3).
Client policy (§6.3): 601 -> reconnect with backoff (1 s base, ×2, 30 s cap, ±20% jitter; reset on READY).
